newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fed's Greenspan to meet MOF minister on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Greenspan to meet MOF minister on Monday.

text.p: U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan will make a courtesy call on Japan's Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka on Monday, November 18, in the morning, a MOF spokesman said on Friday.
Their meeting at the government ministry will start at 10.10 a.m. (0110 GMT).
Greenspan is visiting Japan from November 17 to 19 and will also meet Bank of Japan (BOJ) Governor Yasuo Matsushita on Monday.
